title: Production Planning Software for Manufacturers
seoTitle: Production Planning Software for Indian Manufacturers
seoDescription: How custom production planning software helps Indian SME manufacturers schedule jobs, balance machine capacity, track WIP and connect to Tally.
summary: Production planning software turns sales orders into a realistic schedule: which job runs on which machine, when material must arrive and when the order will ship. For Indian SME manufacturers who plan on whiteboards and Excel, a focused planning system usually brings the biggest early gain in on-time delivery and visibility.

dataPoints.label: Replaces
dataPoints.value: Whiteboards, Excel schedules and daily phone calls to the shop floor

dataPoints.label: Core modules
dataPoints.value: Order intake, bill of materials, machine capacity, job scheduling, work-in-progress tracking

dataPoints.label: Integrations
dataPoints.value: Tally or ERP for orders and stock; WhatsApp for supervisor updates

dataPoints.label: Typical users
dataPoints.value: Planning head, production supervisors, stores, sales coordinators

body:
## Problems it solves

- Sales promises dates the plant cannot meet.
- Machines sit idle while others are overloaded.
- Material shortages are discovered on the day a job should start.
- Nobody can answer "where is my order?" without walking the floor.

## What a first version includes

| Area | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Orders | Pulls confirmed orders from Tally or entry screens |
| Capacity | Hours available per machine and shift |
| Schedule | Drag-and-drop plan with clash warnings |
| Material check | Flags jobs whose inputs are not in stock |
| Shop-floor updates | Supervisors mark start and finish on a phone |

## Build or buy

ERP planning modules suit standard processes. Custom planning makes sense when your routing, changeovers or job-work steps do not fit the package. See [ERP for manufacturing SMEs: build, buy or customise](/blog/erp-for-manufacturing-smes-build-buy-or-customise).

Want to see what this would look like for your business? [Book a 30-minute scoping call](/book-consultation).

faqs.q: Can it work with our existing ERP?
faqs.a: Yes. Planning software can read orders and stock from your ERP or Tally and write back completions.
No. A simple mobile screen for start, finish and issues is usually enough.
